study.hypothesis: Disentangling each complete pooled field into an atomic representation unit preserves useful within-field coordinate relationships before shared projection/interaction, improving four-task validation macro AUC over equally sparse coordinate partitions and full-summary replicas. This is a provisional implementation hypothesis, not an established semantic mechanism. A token-count/capacity increase can independently explain improvement over the historical parent.

nearest_work.difference: Pinned commit 90bb99a60724e975ec565836266fd86dcad0039d, text hash ff8b2e9cf9112ff50a807e1b85b8236ecaa699f842b93b6209630cace8b454a3, lines 113-159: target pooling then field-shaped history/static/target tokens and task tokens. We inherit the general pooled-field precedent but use global plus four rank-quartile summaries, shared sparse content projection, masked JointBlock and raw bypasses; no hierarchical heterogeneous attention or task-token readout. Original paper is not audited; no originality or exact reproduction claim.

Same pinned commit, text hash 4a05e5a0b1c06df6e78832ca42febec8257b961d9bd8e96e2369b9b377dfe332, lines 122-195: target pooling, concatenated or field-shaped tokenization, token mixing and per-token FFNs. Our modulo-coordinate control tests field boundary preservation with the existing attention block, rather than implementing RankMixer. The source supports field input, so it is not accurately described as chunk-only.

Cached primary benchmark section 2.3 (arxiv:2607.19987v2), hash 34ff9c412b35f3118aae377faca5f658d7bffac0b4ef1c12a4eb0c7937372789, establishes broad field/event and pooled-token precedents. Our local partition contrasts neither reproduce nor rank those published methods.

inherited_components: From g0-r0001-grouped_recency (source 9bd0b510eda97fea3c589e562b502c75a6712c18b34766954dae76436dff20aa): embedding tables, original scalar DIN local activation, global plus four ordinal-rank quartile masks, raw static/global summary bypass, count features, masked pre-norm JointBlock, and four Dice towers.
From DIN baseline: unnormalized target-aware local activation over six item fields, historical action in values, four binary prediction heads.
No field-specific retrieval, new label information, user-specific memory, pretrained data, history extension, loss changes or optimizer overrides are introduced.
study.proposed_difference: Replace three semantic field-group masks with seven complete-field masks, seven deterministic coordinate partitions, or seven norm-matched whole-summary replicas. The three standalone modules differ only in CONFIG and constructor representation_mode defaults. Each uses the same shared (112+1)-to-32 projection, 35 history tokens and identical trainable shapes. Whole fields/coordinates are split after the same original target-weighted pooling; this does not restore event-level information lost during pooling. The parent remains a performance/cost comparison with acknowledged extra-token capacity confounding.
predictions: Primary confirmatory contrast: atomic_fields has higher full validation macro AUC than coordinate_partition; secondary confirmatory contrast: atomic_fields has higher macro AUC than replica_seven. Any result is single-seed preliminary.

If generic partitioning suffices, atomic_fields and coordinate_partition will both outperform replica_seven without a consistent atomic-field advantage; this distinguishes a rival explanation from the proposed field-unit mechanism.

Report all four tasks and Logloss without a per-task veto. Long-history improvements are exploratory; do not infer history synergy from a winning cell. Empty-history inputs have no valid history tokens, so any trained-model slice difference can arise indirectly from optimization.

All three variants have exactly equal parameter counts and nominal operation shapes; all incur more interaction/tower cost than the parent. Actual wall/inference cost must be measured, never inferred as an efficiency win.
falsifiers: Atomic fields failing to exceed the matched coordinate partition falsifies the proposed positive field-boundary contrast at this implementation/seed; it does not refute all field representations.
Replicas matching or beating atomic fields falsifies the claimed partition advantage for this recipe.
If gains occur only against the smaller parent, or disappear under paired repetition, capacity/seed explanations remain and a semantic-mechanism claim is unsupported.
Any nonfinite probability/loss/gradient, shape violation, or effect of changing masked IDs/task masks outside visibility/current action invalidates that implementation before training.
alternative_explanations: Added tokens and tower parameters rather than granularity may improve parent comparison.
Sparse partitioning, token identities, embedding basis constraints, count duplication or projection/LayerNorm conditioning may explain gains without semantically meaningful units.
Embedding initialization, shared four-task optimization and calibration can create task-specific tradeoffs; the existing purchase Logloss deterioration is unresolved.

Official offline historical feedback visibility and category/brand auxiliary-label semantics limit transfer to online impression-time prediction. No raw timestamps or matured-feedback guarantees are available.
Validation reuse and limited seed evidence can favor chance differences. No closed-test source or outcomes are authorized.

contrasts.intervention: atomic_fields: each complete 16-dimensional pooled item/action field becomes one of seven summary tokens.
contrasts.control: coordinate_partition: seven deterministic disjoint 16-coordinate tokens, assignment j modulo 7 on the concatenated 112-dimensional summary. Same trainable source except mode default/config. Each token spans multiple fields; no random partition search.

Frozen seed 20262027, one epoch, batch 8192, BF16/TF32-off, split optimizers, sum of four BCEs; no training-loss hook.

Identical seven-token shapes per summary, 35 history tokens, trainable parameter dimensions, buffer size, initialization order, raw static/global bypasses, scalar DIN scorer, five visible-rank summary masks, log counts, JointBlock and towers.
Same ordered item fields from FeatureMap; only the fixed content-selection buffer changes; current target action forced to zero and invalid history IDs sanitized before embedding.
remaining_confounds: Field-aligned masks preserve learned embedding rotations within each field; coordinate masks impose a different embedding optimization geometry. That inductive bias is part of the intervention, not proof of semantic reasoning.
Within-token norm distribution and cross-coordinate covariance are not equalized, although total content squared norm is exactly preserved.
Both arms change token count/tower capacity relative to the three-group parent; only the within-round contrast isolates boundary preservation.
One frozen training seed and repeated validation selection cannot establish repeated support or unbiased generalization.
contrasts.decision_if_supported: If atomic_fields exceeds coordinate_partition on validation macro AUC, retain intact-field units as a provisional local inductive bias; inspect all tasks and slices, and reserve paired repetitions before claiming reliability. Do not claim novelty or temporal synergy.
contrasts.decision_if_not_supported: If atomic_fields is equal or worse, reject the claim that intact field boundaries are necessary in this implementation; select by the frozen macro-AUC rule and investigate generic partitioning or summary/readout calibration only if admissible resources remain.

contrasts.decision_if_not_supported: If replicas match or exceed both partitions, retain the best valid model by the frozen selection policy; do not infer that fieldwise pooling or HiFormer is generally ineffective.

Never exceed the fixed 1208.541376s per-trial cap or original campaign deadline; recompute available wall time before launch and stop if the full admissible unit plus outstanding reserves cannot fit. Preserve failure receipts; unknown execution state does not authorize duplicate execution. No raised caps, training recipe changes, installations, or agent launches.

knowledge_assessments.rationale: Read pinned forward and tokenizer source; pooled fieldwise tokenization is nearest established precedent. Latest declared use executed a positive grouping contrast in both temporal cells but negative temporal interaction; this motivates stricter boundary controls, not a mechanism confirmation.
knowledge_assessments.transformed_mechanism: Seven intact pooled item/action field units per global/quartile summary, compared with coordinate partitions and norm-matched replicas under the inherited masked interaction scaffold.
knowledge_assessments.nearest_work_difference: Shared sparse content-selection projection and five summaries, raw bypass/flattened towers; no HiFormer heterogeneous hierarchical blocks/task token readout. Original paper not audited; novelty unverified.
knowledge_assessments.falsifier: Atomic fields fail to beat coordinate_partition or replica_seven on frozen macro AUC.

knowledge_assessments.rationale: Pinned source handles both field-shaped and concatenated inputs. It motivates a coordinate-partition rival; it does not provide local evidence that any tokenizer or mixer transfers.
knowledge_assessments.transformed_mechanism: Deterministic modulo-coordinate partition control only; no RankMixer token mixing or per-token FFN adopted.
knowledge_assessments.nearest_work_difference: Same inherited attention and readout in all arms; no RankMixer reproduction or superiority claim.
knowledge_assessments.falsifier: If arbitrary coordinate partitions perform as well as whole-field masks, a strong field-boundary claim is unsupported.

knowledge_assessments.rationale: Returned by the current nearest-work search. Benchmark section 2.3 provides field/event token provenance; full original source/paper not newly audited here. Neither prior declared use nor best-cell validation establishes benefit of direct event exchange.
knowledge_assessments.transformed_mechanism: No new event-token attention is adopted; retain compressed-history scaffold already in the incumbent.
knowledge_assessments.nearest_work_difference: Thirty-five pooled representation tokens rather than full/sliding event attention; the proposed tests do not measure TokenFormer effectiveness.
